hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: For evaluation node v, define E_v[F] = F|_{z=v}. Then G0002 = E_x[f(z)] = f(x), G0003 = E_y[f(z)] = f(y), and G0001 = (E_x[f(z)] + E_y[f(z)])/(x - y).
required_assumptions: f is an uninterpreted unary function
x and y are distinct symbolic variables so the denominator x - y is nonzero
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: All three catalog expressions are built from one formal unary function f evaluated at x and y. G0002 and G0003 are direct point evaluations, while G0001 is a symmetric rational combination of those evaluations. This is a structural shared-master-function explanation, not a physical interpretation.
